newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's EVN 9-mth pre-tax down 11.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austria's EVN 9-mth pre-tax down 11.9 pct.

text.p: Austrian regional utility EVN Energie-Versorgung Niederoesterreich AG on Wednesday posted an 11.9 percent drop in pre-tax profit to 1.923 schillings in the first nine months of the year ending August 31.
The company said it would pay an unchanged dividend of 25 schillings plus a bonus.
EVN said due to seasonal differences the second half result could not be calculated from the result so far.
"The business development in the first nine months was in line with expectations and forms a solid basis for a successful conclusion of the full year," the company said in a statement.

EVN's operating result was up 17.6 percent on the year ago period at 1.615 million schillings, which it attributed to favourable conditions in the energy market last year, compared with the high gas prices of the current year.
The company said it planned to build up its core businesses further and continue its rationalisation programme. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
